story: Bladon Springs State Park is located in Choctaw County, Alabama, on the site of four mineral springs. It is a public recreation area and a stop on the Alabama Black Belt Birding Trail.
matters: The park features sulfur-fixing bacteria in its spring water and offers camping, picnicking, and playground facilities.
